svg.aria-label: Five layers from top to bottom: presentation pages per role; client logic in the browser or app; the Supabase API gateway; business logic as private functions and triggers inside PostgreSQL; and data tables with Row Level Security plus storage buckets.
svg.text: Treasurer: Home · Members · Requests · Messages · Insights
SAS: Dashboard · Approvals · Orgs & clubs · Insights · Students · Accredited · School year · Activity log · Messages
Shared: Landing · Sign in · Receipt · My account · Notifications · Ask E-CFunds · Present mode
React Query cache · sign-in and role routing · live refresh (Realtime, 30 s backup)
push + local notifications · app updates (OTA) and website updates (service worker) · offline mode
PDF / CSV / Excel exports · Financial Report · 5-minute auto logout · Back-button guard
Data API (PostgREST): tables + public function wrappers · Auth: email, Google, Student ID
Realtime: live_changes, messages, notifications · Storage API: logos, receipts
Edge Functions: push (Firebase, Web Push) · chat (Gemini) · student-login
private SECURITY DEFINER functions: record_payment · file_request · file_resolution · review_resolution
triggers: notify · audit · live_tick · ledger guard · pg_cron reminders · pg_net → push
school_years · semesters · entities · students · profiles · memberships · receipts
ledger_entries (append-only) · fund_requests · expense_items · notifications · messages · cleared_items · audit log
Row Level Security on every table · buckets: logos (public), receipts (private, one folder per org)
